# `silk/bool`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Named primitive Boolean equality and negation operations.

## When to use

Prefer `==`, `!=`, and `!` in ordinary expressions. Import [`equals`](#declaration-73696c6b2f626f6f6c3a3a657175616c73), [`notEquals`](#declaration-73696c6b2f626f6f6c3a3a6e6f74457175616c73), or [`not`](#declaration-73696c6b2f626f6f6c3a3a6e6f74)
when an operation must be passed or selected by name.

## Details

These functions are thin, allocation-free calls to the same concrete Boolean primitives the
operators use; they add no Effect channels or alternate truth semantics.

Import as `bool` with `import silk.bool`.

Public declarations: 3.
